Q: Consider the polynomial \( p(x) = 2x^4 - 3x^3 + 5x^2 - 7x + 6 \). Which of the following statements is true regarding the irreducibility of \( p(x) \) over the field of rational numbers \( \mathbb{Q} \)?

A. \( p(x) \) is irreducible over \( \mathbb{Q} \) by the Rational Root Theorem.

B. \( p(x) \) can be factored into the product of two quadratic polynomials over \( \mathbb{Q} \).

C. \( p(x) \) is reducible over \( \mathbb{Q} \)
